entities.summary: Derrick Rowland is a retired American professional basketball player who is in his second stint as the head coach of the Albany Patroons of The Basketball League (TBL). He previously worked as the head coach of the Potawatomi Fire of TBL in the Fire's inaugural season (2022). Born in Brookhaven, New York, during his playing career, he was a 6'5" tall, 195-pound shooting guard.
